resourceTypes.summary: Manage a regular file's content and metadata.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path of the managed file.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Literal file content, or an encrypted secret reference { secret: <path> } (a path relative to the recipe, to an age file; unreleased, after v1.1.3). A secret-backed file is always sensitive. Mutually exclusive with source.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Controller-side file copied to path. Mutually exclusive with content.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: motd
    type: file
    with:
      path: /etc/motd
      content: "managed by sinter\n"
      mode: "0644"
      owner: root
      group: root

resourceTypes.summary: Ensure a directory exists with the desired metadata.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path of the managed directory.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: appdir
    type: directory
    with:
      path: /opt/myapp
      mode: "0755"
      owner: root
      group: root

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Symlink target. Required when state is present.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: vimrc
    type: link
    with:
      path: /etc/vim/vimrc.local
      target: /opt/myapp/vimrc.local

resourceTypes.summary: Render a controller-side template file to a managed path.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Controller-side template path, resolved relative to the recipe.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: app_conf
    type: template
    with:
      path: /etc/myapp/config.ini
      source: templates/config.ini
      mode: "0640"
      vars:
        listen_port: 8080

resourceTypes.summary: Execute a program on the target with exact argv and a fixed environment baseline.

parameters.name: env
parameters.description: Extra environment variables. PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, HOME are reserved.

parameters.name: creates
parameters.description: Guard: skip execution when this path exists. Mutually exclusive with removes.

parameters.name: removes
parameters.description: Guard: skip execution when this path does not exist. Mutually exclusive with creates.

parameters.name: changed_when
parameters.description: Expression over result.<field> deciding whether the run counts as changed.

parameters.name: register
parameters.description: Name under which the structured result is stored for later expressions.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: update_index
    type: command
    with:
      program: /usr/bin/touch
      args: ["/var/lib/myapp/indexed"]
      creates: /var/lib/myapp/indexed

resourceTypes.summary: Install or remove a package via the target's package backend (apt or dnf).

parameters.name: env
parameters.description: Environment variables for this package operation; not persistent host configuration.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: install-tools
    type: package
    with:
      name: curl
      state: present
      env:
        HTTP_PROXY: "http://proxy.example.com:3128"
        HTTPS_PROXY: "http://proxy.example.com:3128"
        NO_PROXY: "localhost,127.0.0.1,.example.internal"

resourceTypes.summary: Manage a systemd service's run state and enablement.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether the unit is enabled. At least one of state or enabled is required.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: sshd
    type: service
    with:
      name: sshd
      state: running
      enabled: true

resourceTypes.summary: UNRELEASED (after v1.1.3): ensure a local Linux group exists or is absent, with an optional fixed gid.

parameters.name: gid
parameters.description: Required gid (1-4294967294). An existing group with a different gid is refused, never renumbered.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Create a system group. Create-time only.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: app_group
    type: group
    with:
      name: app
      gid: 990
      system: true

resourceTypes.summary: UNRELEASED (after v1.1.3): ensure a local Linux user exists or is absent, with optional uid, primary group, shell, home record and additive supplementary groups.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: present or absent. absent runs userdel without -r or -f.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Required uid (1-4294967294). An existing user with a different uid is refused, never renumbered.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Primary group, by name. It must exist; list the creating group resource in depends_on.

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: Supplementary groups, by name. Additive: never removes membership.

parameters.name: home
parameters.description: Home directory record. Nothing is created or moved.

parameters.name: create_home
parameters.description: Create the home directory (useradd -m). Create-time only.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Create a system user. Create-time only.

parameters.name: password_hash
parameters.description: Password hash (not the password) kept as an encrypted secret; one $y$ or $6$ hash. Needs --sudo. Always sensitive; set with chpasswd -e on stdin. Unreleased.

resourceTypes.example:
resources:
  - id: app_group
    type: group
    with:
      name: app
      gid: 990
      system: true
  - id: app_user
    type: user
    depends_on: [app_group]
    with:
      name: app
      uid: 990
      group: app
      shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
      home: /var/lib/app
      system: true
